title: The world's following gauge before and after the 2026-09-23 fix, on the same orders
gauge: env.py _command_response: per body part with strength above 0 and an asked turn of at least 1e-4 rad, the cosine between the turn asked (ordered orientation against the pose when the order was entered) and the turn made; averaged over the scored parts. -1 = every part turned exactly against its order, 0 = unrelated to the order, +1 = exactly as ordered. cmd_response = over one 10 ms frame; cmd_response_slow = over one order's tenure. The trainer's stats rows: cmd_response_cos (the 10 ms reading on the last frame of each model step), cmd_response_cos_held (the tenure reading), follow_bout (the 10 ms reading, averaged over babble bouts), cmd_mag_rad (the mean asked turn).

what_changed.rows: the eyes' row is found by name (row 23); before, the LAST row was skipped as the eyes, which in trunk_v1 (26 rows) is the chest, and the eyes' row was scored
what_changed.span: an order is scored over cmd_horizon = 25 frames (250 ms); before, 26
what_changed.trainer_sampling: train_mimo averages the held reading only on the last model step of each held order, where the 25 frames are exactly that order's tenure; before, every model step's reading went in

seeded_orders_in_segment_31_world.setup: train_mimo.env_kwargs_for(seg31 args.json, phase 'mature'), 1 body, CPU, vision off, caregiver recording off, seed 0; 2,000 model steps (400 orders); an order latched every 5 model steps of 5 frames, executed = 0.35 x new + 0.65 x previous (smooth_actions 0.35); each new order turns every body part 10-60 degrees about its own random axis from its current pose, position target +-3 cm, strength 0.2-0.7 per part, and writes an eye command (azimuth and elevation 0.4 rad at most) into the eyes' row the way lem_model.gaze_to_handle does. The world ran the fixed code; HEAD's function and queue ran beside it on the same arguments at the same moments.

live_model_orders_new_gauge.source: the per-part rows of docs/gain_of_function_v3/measurements/following_out_of_100.json's live case (ckpt_step_344400 acting in its saved world, 5 bodies, 245 orders, learning off): each row's cos is the gauge's per-part cosine from the latch to the next latch, 25 frames, eyes' row left out, chest scored - the fixed held gauge
live_model_orders_new_gauge.old_gauge_on_segment_31_stats: replay_training_stats.jsonl of segment 31, 161 records (steps 328,400-344,400): cmd_response_cos_held mean 0.1398 (0.1084-0.1709), cmd_response_cos 0.0473, follow_bout 0.0714, cmd_mag_rad 0.4485

scripts.measure:
"""Before/after of the env's following gauge on segment 31's world, same seeded orders.

One world (train_mimo.env_kwargs_for on the seg31 args.json, 1 body, CPU, vision off, caregiver
recording off). Orders are latched like the trainer: a new order every motor_hold = 5 model steps,
each model step action_repeat = 5 frames, executed = 0.35 x new + 0.65 x previous (smooth_actions).
The world runs the FIXED code (eyes' row by name, slow queue popped at cmd_horizon). Every call of
env._command_response is shadowed, at the same moment and on the same arguments, by:
  old  = HEAD's function (eyes' row = LAST row) with HEAD's queue (popped at cmd_horizon + 1)
  mix  = the fixed function with HEAD's queue (to split the row fix from the span fix)
and per-row detail (direction cosine, closer-or-not) for counts per 100.
Stats are formed as train_mimo forms them: the last frame of each model step.
"""
import json, math, os, sys, time, types
os.environ["CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES"] = "-1"
REPO = r"D:\UEMA_Research"
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(REPO, "Source", "Python"))
import numpy as np

STEPS = int(os.environ.get("STEPS", "1000"))
SEED = int(os.environ.get("SEED", "0"))
SCRATCH = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
OUT = os.path.join(SCRATCH, os.environ.get("OUT_NAME", "gauge_before_after.json"))

from mimo_bridge.train_mimo import env_kwargs_for
from mimo_bridge.env import BridgeEnv
from mimo_bridge.action_decoder import quat_xyzw_to_mat, rotmat_log
from mimo_bridge.tools.command_following import _turn, rest_order

RUN = os.path.join(REPO, "Saved", "mimo_bridge", "experiments", "H84_fresh_drivers_20260918_seg31_toy_and_push")
a = json.load(open(os.path.join(RUN, "args.json")))
ns = types.SimpleNamespace(**a)
kw = env_kwargs_for(ns, "mature", os.path.join(SCRATCH, "gauge_run"))
kw.update(caregiver_record_dir="", vision=False, tag="_rowfix", seed=SEED)
HOLD, REPS, SMOOTH = int(a["motor_hold"]), int(a["action_repeat"]), float(a["smooth_actions"])
env = BridgeEnv(**kw)
H = env._cmd_horizon
assert H == HOLD * REPS == 25, H
names = list(env.proprio.handle_names)
n = len(names)
GAZE, CHEST, LAST = names.index("gaze"), names.index("chest"), n - 1
print("layout rows", n, "gaze", GAZE, "last", names[LAST], "dt", env.dt, flush=True)


def gauge(motor, xp_before, xq_before, w_before, hist, record_window, gaze_idx, handle_mask=None):
    """env._command_response verbatim (HEAD == fixed except the gaze_idx line), with its own window."""
    d = env.data
    cos_list, ratio_list, acc_list = [], [], []
    w_after = env._handle_angvel()
    pos_cos, cmd_mags = [], []
    for i, b in enumerate(env.proprio.body_ids):
        if i == gaze_idx:
            continue
        if motor[i, 8] <= 0 or (handle_mask is not None and not handle_mask[i]):
            continue
        q0 = xq_before[i]; R0 = quat_xyzw_to_mat([q0[1], q0[2], q0[3], q0[0]])
        q1 = d.xquat[b]; R1 = quat_xyzw_to_mat([q1[1], q1[2], q1[3], q1[0]])
        Rt = quat_xyzw_to_mat(motor[i, 3:7])
        w_cmd = rotmat_log(Rt @ R0.T); w_got = rotmat_log(R1 @ R0.T)
        nc, ng = np.linalg.norm(w_cmd), np.linalg.norm(w_got)
        if nc < 1e-4:
            continue
        cos_list.append(float(np.dot(w_cmd, w_got) / (nc * max(ng, 1e-9))) if ng > 1e-6 else 0.0)
        cmd_mags.append(nc)
        e_cmd = np.clip(motor[i, 0:3] / 100.0 - xp_before[i], -0.5, 0.5)
        npc = float(np.linalg.norm(e_cmd))
        if npc > 1e-3:
            dpos = np.asarray(d.xpos[b], dtype=np.float64) - xp_before[i]
            ndp = float(np.linalg.norm(dpos))
            pos_cos.append(float(np.dot(e_cmd, dpos) / (npc * ndp)) if ndp > 1e-5 else 0.0)
        ratio_list.append(float(ng / nc))
        dw = w_after[i] - w_before[i]; nd = np.linalg.norm(dw)
        acc_list.append(float(np.dot(w_cmd, dw) / (nc * nd)) if nd > 1e-6 else 0.0)
    w_cmd_all = np.zeros((n, 3))
    for i, b in enumerate(env.proprio.body_ids):
        if i == gaze_idx:
            continue
        if motor[i, 8] <= 0 or (handle_mask is not None and not handle_mask[i]):
            continue
        q0 = xq_before[i]; R0 = quat_xyzw_to_mat([q0[1], q0[2], q0[3], q0[0]])
        w_cmd_all[i] = rotmat_log(quat_xyzw_to_mat(motor[i, 3:7]) @ R0.T)
    if record_window:
        hist.append((w_cmd_all, np.array(xq_before)))
        if len(hist) > env._cmd_window:
            hist.pop(0)
    win_cos = []
    if len(hist) == env._cmd_window:
        asked = np.sum([h[0] for h in hist], axis=0); xq_start = hist[0][1]
        for i, b in enumerate(env.proprio.body_ids):
            na = np.linalg.norm(asked[i])
            if na < 1e-3:
                continue
            qs = xq_start[i]; Rs = quat_xyzw_to_mat([qs[1], qs[2], qs[3], qs[0]])
            q1 = d.xquat[b]; R1 = quat_xyzw_to_mat([q1[1], q1[2], q1[3], q1[0]])
            got = rotmat_log(R1 @ Rs.T); ng = np.linalg.norm(got)
            win_cos.append(float(np.dot(asked[i], got) / (na * ng)) if ng > 1e-4 else 0.0)
    win = float(np.mean(win_cos)) if win_cos else 0.0
    if not cos_list:
        return {"cos": 0.0, "n": 0, "window_cos": win, "ratio": 0.0, "acc_cos": 0.0,
                "pos_cos": float(np.mean(pos_cos)) if pos_cos else 0.0,
                "cmd_mag": float(np.mean(cmd_mags)) if cmd_mags else 0.0}
    return {"cos": float(np.mean(cos_list)), "n": len(cos_list), "window_cos": win,
            "ratio": float(np.mean(ratio_list)), "acc_cos": float(np.mean(acc_list)),
            "pos_cos": float(np.mean(pos_cos)) if pos_cos else 0.0,
            "cmd_mag": float(np.mean(cmd_mags)) if cmd_mags else 0.0}


def rows(motor, xq_before):
    """Per row: (direction cosine, ended closer to the ordered orientation, asked turn rad), NaN when
    the gauge would skip the row for strength 0 or an asked turn under 1e-4 rad."""
    out = np.full((n, 3), np.nan)
    for i, b in enumerate(env.proprio.body_ids):
        if motor[i, 8] <= 0:
            continue
        q0 = xq_before[i]; R0 = quat_xyzw_to_mat([q0[1], q0[2], q0[3], q0[0]])
        q1 = env.data.xquat[b]; R1 = quat_xyzw_to_mat([q1[1], q1[2], q1[3], q1[0]])
        Rt = quat_xyzw_to_mat(motor[i, 3:7])
        w_cmd = rotmat_log(Rt @ R0.T); w_got = rotmat_log(R1 @ R0.T)
        nc, ng = np.linalg.norm(w_cmd), np.linalg.norm(w_got)
        if nc < 1e-4:
            continue
        c = float(np.dot(w_cmd, w_got) / (nc * ng)) if ng > 1e-6 else 0.0
        d_after = np.linalg.norm(rotmat_log(Rt @ R1.T))
        out[i] = (c, float(d_after < nc), nc)
    return out


shadow = {"hist_old": [], "hist_mix": [], "q_old": [], "q_new": [], "last": None}
orig = env._command_response


def wrapped(motor, xp_before, xq_before, w_before, handle_mask=None, record_window=True):
    r = orig(motor, xp_before, xq_before, w_before, handle_mask=handle_mask, record_window=record_window)
    fr = int(env.frame)                     # frames completed, this one included
    if record_window:                       # the per-frame (fast) call, then the slow one
        rec = {"fast_old": gauge(motor, xp_before, xq_before, w_before, shadow["hist_old"], True, LAST),
               "fast_new": r, "rows_fast": rows(motor, xq_before)}
        # sanity: the fixed function reproduced
        mix_fast = gauge(motor, xp_before, xq_before, w_before, shadow["hist_mix"], True, GAZE)
        for k in ("cos", "n", "window_cos", "ratio", "acc_cos", "pos_cos", "cmd_mag"):
            assert abs(mix_fast[k] - r[k]) < 1e-12, (k, mix_fast[k], r[k])
        shadow["q_old"].append((np.array(motor, dtype=np.float64), xp_before.copy(), xq_before.copy(), fr))
        shadow["q_new"].append(fr)
        if len(shadow["q_old"]) > H:        # HEAD's queue: popped at cmd_horizon + 1 entries
            mo, xp0, xq0, f0 = shadow["q_old"].pop(0)
            rec["slow_old"] = gauge(mo, xp0, xq0, w_before, shadow["hist_old"], False, LAST)
            rec["slow_mix"] = gauge(mo, xp0, xq0, w_before, shadow["hist_mix"], False, GAZE)
            rec["rows_slow_old"] = rows(mo, xq0)
            rec["span_old"] = fr - f0 + 1
        shadow["last"] = rec
    else:
        rec = shadow["last"]
        if len(shadow["q_new"]) > H - 1:
            del shadow["q_new"][:len(shadow["q_new"]) - H]
        f0 = shadow["q_new"].pop(0)
        rec["slow_new"] = r
        rec["rows_slow_new"] = rows(motor, xq_before)
        rec["span_new"] = fr - f0 + 1
    return r


env._command_response = wrapped


def gaze_quat(az, el):
    ca, sa, ce, se = math.cos(az / 2), math.sin(az / 2), math.cos(el / 2), math.sin(el / 2)
    return np.array([-sa * se, ca * se, sa * ce, ca * ce])      # lem_model.LemLite.gaze_to_handle


rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
env.reset()
for _ in range(20):
    env.step(rest_order(env, n), None, None, render=False)
shadow.update(hist_old=[], hist_mix=[], q_old=[], q_new=[])
env._cmd_hist, env._cmd_delay = [], []
steps = []
prev = None
t0 = time.time()
az = el = 0.0
for s in range(STEPS):
    order_age = s % HOLD
    if order_age == 0:
        prop = rest_order(env, n)
        for i in range(n):
            if i == GAZE:
                continue
            prop[i, 3:7] = _turn(prop[i, 3:7], rng.normal(size=3), math.radians(rng.uniform(10.0, 60.0)))
            prop[i, 0:3] += rng.normal(0.0, 3.0, 3)
        az, el = rng.uniform(-0.4, 0.4, 2)
        prop[GAZE, 3:7] = gaze_quat(az, el)
        prop[:, 8] = rng.uniform(0.2, 0.7, n)
        if prev is None:
            exe = prop.copy()
        else:
            exe = SMOOTH * prop + (1 - SMOOTH) * prev
            for i in range(n):
                qp, qn = prev[i, 3:7], prop[i, 3:7]
                if np.dot(qp, qn) < 0:
                    qn = -qn
                q = SMOOTH * qn + (1 - SMOOTH) * qp
                exe[i, 3:7] = q / np.linalg.norm(q)
        prev = exe
        t_latch = float(env.data.time)
    for rep in range(REPS):
        out = env.step(exe, (float(az), float(el)), None, render=False)
    rec = shadow["last"]
    steps.append(dict(
        s=s, age=order_age,
        fast_old_all={k: rec["fast_old"].get(k) for k in ("window_cos", "ratio", "acc_cos", "pos_cos", "cmd_mag")},
        fast_new_all={k: rec["fast_new"].get(k) for k in ("window_cos", "ratio", "acc_cos", "pos_cos", "cmd_mag")},
        fast_old=rec["fast_old"]["cos"], fast_new=rec["fast_new"]["cos"],
        fast_n_old=rec["fast_old"]["n"], fast_n_new=rec["fast_new"]["n"],
        slow_old=rec.get("slow_old", {}).get("cos"), slow_mix=rec.get("slow_mix", {}).get("cos"),
        slow_new=rec.get("slow_new", {}).get("cos"),
        slow_n_old=rec.get("slow_old", {}).get("n"), slow_n_new=rec.get("slow_new", {}).get("n"),
        span_old=rec.get("span_old"), span_new=rec.get("span_new"),
        sim_since_latch=float(env.data.time) - t_latch,
        info_slow=(out.info.get("cmd_response_slow") or {}).get("cos"),
        rows_slow_new=None if rec.get("rows_slow_new") is None else rec["rows_slow_new"].tolist(),
        rows_slow_old=None if rec.get("rows_slow_old") is None else rec["rows_slow_old"].tolist(),
        rows_fast=rec["rows_fast"].tolist()))
    assert steps[-1]["info_slow"] == steps[-1]["slow_new"]
    if s % 200 == 0:
        print(f"step {s} {time.time() - t0:.0f}s", flush=True)
env.close()
json.dump(dict(steps=steps, names=names, gaze=GAZE, chest=CHEST, last=LAST, H=H, hold=HOLD, reps=REPS,
               seed=SEED, dt=env.dt, seconds=time.time() - t0, kw={k: str(v) for k, v in kw.items()}),
          open(OUT, "w"), default=float)
print("done", OUT, flush=True)
scripts.analyse:
import json, sys, os
import numpy as np

P = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "gauge_before_after.json")
d = json.load(open(P))
S = d["steps"]
G, C, L, HOLD = d["gaze"], d["chest"], d["last"], d["hold"]
N = len(S)


def mean(v):
    v = [x for x in v if x is not None]
    return (float(np.mean(v)), len(v)) if v else (None, 0)


def halves(key_fn, sel=lambda r: True):
    a = [key_fn(r) for r in S[:N // 2] if sel(r)]
    b = [key_fn(r) for r in S[N // 2:] if sel(r)]
    return mean(a)[0], mean(b)[0]


out = {}
tend = lambda r: r["age"] == HOLD - 1
out["cmd_response_cos (fast, 10 ms)"] = dict(old=mean([r["fast_old"] for r in S]), new=mean([r["fast_new"] for r in S]),
                                             old_halves=halves(lambda r: r["fast_old"]), new_halves=halves(lambda r: r["fast_new"]))
for k in ("window_cos", "ratio", "acc_cos", "pos_cos", "cmd_mag"):
    out[f"fast {k}"] = dict(old=mean([r["fast_old_all"][k] for r in S]), new=mean([r["fast_new_all"][k] for r in S]))
out["cmd_response_cos_held"] = dict(
    old_every_step_26_frames_last_row_as_eyes=mean([r["slow_old"] for r in S]),
    rows_fixed_every_step_26_frames=mean([r["slow_mix"] for r in S]),
    rows_fixed_every_step_25_frames=mean([r["slow_new"] for r in S]),
    new_tenure_end_25_frames=mean([r["slow_new"] for r in S if tend(r)]),
    old_halves=halves(lambda r: r["slow_old"]),
    new_halves=halves(lambda r: r["slow_new"], tend))
out["spans_frames"] = dict(old=sorted({r["span_old"] for r in S if r["span_old"]}),
                           new=sorted({r["span_new"] for r in S if r["span_new"]}),
                           sim_s_latch_to_tenure_end=sorted({round(r["sim_since_latch"], 4) for r in S if tend(r)}))
out["n_zero_readings"] = dict(fast_old=sum(r["fast_n_old"] == 0 for r in S), fast_new=sum(r["fast_n_new"] == 0 for r in S),
                              scored_rows_fast_old=sorted({r["fast_n_old"] for r in S}), scored_rows_fast_new=sorted({r["fast_n_new"] for r in S}))


def per100(rows_key, sel, row_ok, col):
    vals = []
    for r in S:
        if not sel(r) or r[rows_key] is None:
            continue
        for i, row in enumerate(r[rows_key]):
            if row_ok(i) and row[0] is not None and np.isfinite(row[0]):
                vals.append(row[col])
    if not vals:
        return None
    v = np.array(vals, dtype=float)
    x = (v > 0).mean() if col == 0 else v.mean()
    return round(100.0 * float(x), 1), len(vals)


every = lambda r: True
out["per_100_part_orders"] = {
    "old gauge as the stats read it (every step, 26 frames, all rows but the last): parts that turned with a component toward the order":
        per100("rows_slow_old", every, lambda i: i != L, 0),
    "new gauge as the stats read it (tenure end, 25 frames, all rows but the eyes'): same count":
        per100("rows_slow_new", tend, lambda i: i != G, 0),
    "new, same rows: parts that ended closer to the ordered orientation":
        per100("rows_slow_new", tend, lambda i: i != G, 1),
    "chest alone, new (tenure end): turned toward": per100("rows_slow_new", tend, lambda i: i == C, 0),
    "chest alone, new (tenure end): ended closer": per100("rows_slow_new", tend, lambda i: i == C, 1),
    "eyes' row alone, as the old gauge scored it (every step, 26 frames): turned toward": per100("rows_slow_old", every, lambda i: i == G, 0),
    "fast (10 ms) eyes' row alone, old: turned toward": per100("rows_fast", every, lambda i: i == G, 0),
    "fast (10 ms) chest alone, new: turned toward": per100("rows_fast", every, lambda i: i == C, 0),
}


def row_mean(rows_key, sel, i, col=0):
    v = [r[rows_key][i][col] for r in S if sel(r) and r[rows_key] is not None and r[rows_key][i][col] is not None
         and np.isfinite(r[rows_key][i][col])]
    return (round(float(np.mean(v)), 4), len(v)) if v else None


out["row_means"] = dict(eyes_slow_old=row_mean("rows_slow_old", every, G), chest_slow_new_tenure=row_mean("rows_slow_new", tend, C),
                        eyes_fast=row_mean("rows_fast", every, G), chest_fast=row_mean("rows_fast", every, C),
                        eyes_asked_turn_rad_fast=row_mean("rows_fast", every, G, 2), chest_asked_turn_rad_fast=row_mean("rows_fast", every, C, 2))
out["steps"], out["orders"], out["seconds"] = N, N // HOLD, d["seconds"]
print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
